title: Moment bound for sign deviations
statement:
Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $f:\Omega\to\{-1,1\}$. For every real $p$ with $1\le p\le2$, the $p$th absolute moment of the deviation from the mean is at most the variance:
\[\mathbb{E}_{x\sim\pi}\bigl[|f(x)-\mathbb{E}_{y\sim\pi}f(y)|^p\bigr]\le\mathbb{E}_{x\sim\pi}\bigl[(f(x)-\mathbb{E}_{y\sim\pi}f(y))^2\bigr].\]
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
